Distribution. Dargida phaeoneura is an Andean species ranging in high-elevation grassland areas above 2000 m from Peru, Bolivia to the Sierras Pampeanas of Argentina. In Argentina it is distributed on both sides of the Aconquija foothills in the provinces of Catamarca and Tucumán, and in the Sierra Grande foothills in the province of Córdoba (Fig. 43).
